prompt: Write the Flisk service.json files for a "cms" stack: a bring-your-own Postgres called "cms-db" (image postgres:16, port 5432, no health path), a migrator called "cms-migrate" that depends on "cms-db", and an HTTP API backend called "cms-api" on port 5300 that depends on "cms-migrate". Reply with a JSON array of the three objects and nothing else.

Write the Flisk service.json files for a "bot" stack: a local model server called "bot-llm" (bring-your-own, image vllm/vllm-openai, port 8000, health check /v1/models), an MCP server called "bot-tools" on port 5400, and an AI agent called "bot-agent" that depends on "bot-llm" and "bot-tools". Reply with a JSON array of the three objects and nothing else.

Write the Flisk service.json files for a "jobs" stack: a bring-your-own RabbitMQ called "jobs-mq" (image rabbitmq:3, port 5672, no health path), a worker called "jobs-runner" that depends on "jobs-mq", and a frontend called "jobs-ui" on port 5173. Reply with a JSON array of the three objects and nothing else.
